Either way, risk is elevated with these companies because there is a chance the product may not come to fruition or the company's addressable market or demand may not be as large as expected. news.title: New minor risk - Share price stability
news.body: The company's share price has been volatile over the past 3 months. It is more volatile than 75% of Indian stocks, typically moving 7.5% a week. This is considered a minor risk. Share price volatility indicates the stock is highly sensitive to market conditions or economic conditions rather than being sensitive to its own business performance, which may also be inconsistent. It also increases the risk of potential losses in the short term as the stock tends to have larger drops in price more frequently than other stocks. news.title: Less than half of directors are independent
news.body: There are 5 new directors who have joined the board in the last 3 years. Of these new board members, 3 were independent directors. The company's board is composed of: 4 independent directors. 5 non-independent directors. Non-Executive Independent Director Akshay Sexena was the last independent director to join the board, commencing their role in 2024. The following issues are considered to be risks according to the Simply Wall St Risk Model: Minority of independent directors. Lack of board continuity.

news.title: Standard Capital Markets Limited Announces Executive Changes, Effective December 18, 2025
news.body: Standard Capital Markets Limited announced that Mr. Ram Gopal Jindal has stepped down from the position of Chairperson but shall remain as the Managing Director of the Company, effective December 18, 2025. The company appointed Mr. Gaurav Jindal appointed as Chairperson of the Company, effective December 18, 2025. of Mr. Gaurav Jindal is associated with the Company and possesses adequate experience and expertise to lead the Company.
